lead_raw_text:
The structure of Y2Zn4Cu4O12 (Y(ZnCu)2O3) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/m (No. 15), with 22 atoms per unit cell distributed over 6 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cu in a tetrahedral environment with 4 O neighbors, while Y adopts an octahedral environment with 6 O neighbors. Corner-sharing between Cu tetrahedra and Y octahedra is observed, and O-centered tetrahedra display corner-, edge-, and face-sharing contacts. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component containing all 22 sites.
